license_required.quote: Only licensees may issue a report on financial statements of any other person, firm, organization or governmental unit or otherwise offer to render or render any attest service.

issuing_authority.quote: "Board" means the state board of accountancy established under § 62-1-104 or its predecessor under prior law

name.quote: "Board" means the state board of accountancy established under § 62-1-104 or its predecessor under prior law

type.quote: "Board" means the state board of accountancy established under § 62-1-104 or its predecessor under prior law

moral_character_required.quote: The certificate of certified public accountant shall be granted to persons of good moral character

degree_required.value: 150 semester hours including baccalaureate or higher degree
degree_required.quote: at least one hundred fifty (150) semester hours of college education, including a baccalaureate or higher degree conferred by a college or university acceptable to the board

required.quote: An applicant for initial issuance of a certificate under this section shall show that the applicant has had one (1) year of experience.

duration.quote: the applicant has had one (1) year of experience

kind.value: accounting, attest, management advisory, financial advisory, tax or consulting skills
kind.quote: providing any type of service or advice involving the use of accounting, attest, management advisory, financial advisory, tax or consulting skills, all of which were verified by a licensee

exams.name: Uniform Certified Public Accountant Examination
exams.notes: Board may use all or any part of the Uniform CPA Examination and Advisory Grading Service of the AICPA; exam held at least twice a year
exams.quote: The board may make such use of all or any part of the Uniform Certified Public Accountant Examination and Advisory Grading Service of the AICPA

interval_years.quote: Certificates shall be initially issued and renewed for periods of no more than two (2) years. Every holder of a certificate as a certified public accountant or a registration as a public accountant shall be required to renew the certificate or registration biennially.

required.quote: For renewal of a certificate under this section, each licensee shall participate in a program of learning designed to maintain professional competency.

hours_per_period.quote: continuing education of eighty (80) credit hours over a two-year period, with a minimum of twenty (20) credit hours in each year as a prerequisite for the renewal of a certificate

period_years.quote: eighty (80) credit hours over a two-year period

available.quote: An individual whose principal place of business is not in this state having a valid license as a certified public accountant from any state that the board or its designee has verified to be in substantial equivalence with the CPA licensure requirements of this chapter shall be presumed to have qualifications substantially equivalent to this state's requirements and shall have all the privileges of licensees of this state without the need to obtain a certificate or permit

requirements.value: Substantial equivalency with TN CPA licensure requirements; no notice or submission required for individuals from substantially equivalent states; individuals from non-verified states must obtain board verification of substantial equivalency
requirements.quote: no notice or other submission shall be provided by the individual. The individual shall be subject to the requirements in subdivision (a)(3).

exists.quote: "Board" means the state board of accountancy established under § 62-1-104 or its predecessor under prior law

national_association.value: American Institute of Certified Public Accountants (AICPA)
national_association.quote: indicating that the service was performed in accordance with standards established by the American Institute of Certified Public Accountants (AICPA)

regulatory_model.quote: Only licensees may issue a report on financial statements of any other person, firm, organization or governmental unit or otherwise offer to render or render any attest service.

credential_type.quote: "License" means a certificate issued under § 62-1-107, a permit issued under § 62-1-108 or a registration under § 62-1-109

is_mandatory.quote: Only licensees may issue a report on financial statements of any other person, firm, organization or governmental unit or otherwise offer to render or render any attest service.

title_protection.quote: No person not holding a valid certificate shall use or assume the title "certified public accountant" or the abbreviation "CPA" or any other title, designation, words, letters, abbreviation, sign, card or device tending to indicate that the person is a certified public accountant.

scope_protection.quote: Only licensees may issue a report on financial statements of any other person, firm, organization or governmental unit or otherwise offer to render or render any attest service.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Fraud or deceit in obtaining a license
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Fraud or deceit in obtaining a license;

disciplinary_grounds.description: Cancellation, revocation, suspension or refusal to renew a license or practice rights for disciplinary reasons in any other state
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Cancellation, revocation, suspension or refusal to renew a license or practice rights for disciplinary reasons in any other state for any cause;

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failure to maintain compliance with requirements for issuance or renewal or to report changes to the board
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failure on the part of a licensee to maintain compliance with the requirements for issuance or renewal of the license or to report changes to the board under § 62-1-107(f) or § 62-1-108(g);

disciplinary_grounds.description: Revocation or suspension of the right to practice before any state or federal agency
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Revocation or suspension of the right to practice before any state or federal agency;

disciplinary_grounds.description: Dishonesty, fraud or gross negligence in the performance of services or in the filing or failure to file income tax returns
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Dishonesty, fraud or gross negligence in the performance of services as a licensee or in the filing or failure to file the licensee's own income tax returns;

disciplinary_grounds.description: Violation of any provision of this chapter, board rules, or professional standards
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Violation of any provision of this chapter or rule promulgated by the board under this chapter or violation of professional standards;

disciplinary_grounds.description: Violation of any rule of professional conduct promulgated by the board
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Violation of any rule of professional conduct promulgated by the board;

disciplinary_grounds.description: Conviction of a felony or crime involving dishonesty or fraud
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Conviction of a felony or of any crime an element of which is dishonesty or fraud under the laws of the United States, of this state, or of any other state or country if the acts involved would have constituted a crime under the laws of this state.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Performance of any fraudulent act while holding a certificate or permit
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Performance of any fraudulent act while holding a certificate or permit issued under this chapter or prior law;

disciplinary_grounds.description: Any conduct reflecting adversely upon the licensee's fitness to perform services
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Any conduct reflecting adversely upon the licensee's fitness to perform services while a licensee;

disciplinary_grounds.description: Making any false or misleading statement or verification in support of an application for a license filed by another
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Making any false or misleading statement or verification in support of an application for a license filed by another;

disciplinary_grounds.description: Violation of the terms of any lawful order entered by the board
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Violation of the terms of any lawful order entered by the board.

establishment_regulation_required.quote: A firm with multiple locations shall obtain a permit for each location. A firm must hold a permit issued under this section in order to provide attest services or to use the title "CPAs," "CPA firm," "PAs" or "PA firm."

definition_quote.value: Only licensees may issue a report on financial statements of any other person, firm, organization or governmental unit or otherwise offer to render or render any attest service. This restriction does not prohibit any act of a public official or public employee in the performance of that person's duties as such, or prohibit the performance by any person of other services involving the use of accounting skills, including the preparation of tax returns, management advisory services and the preparation of financial statements without the issuance of reports thereon.
definition_quote.quote: Only licensees may issue a report on financial statements of any other person, firm, organization or governmental unit or otherwise offer to render or render any attest service.

methods_authorized.quote: providing any type of service or advice involving the use of accounting, attest, management advisory, financial advisory, tax or consulting skills

value: Any audit or other engagement in accordance with SAS
Any review in accordance with SSARS
Any examination in accordance with SSAE
Issuance of any report including compilation reports prescribed by SAS, SSARS, or SSAE
attest_services_types.quote: "Attest" means providing the following services: Any audit or other engagement to be performed in accordance with the Statements on Auditing Standards (SAS); Any review to be performed in accordance with the Statements on Standards for Accounting and Review Services (SSARS); Any examination to be performed in accordance with the Statements on Standards for Attestation Engagements (SSAE); The issuance of any report, including compilation reports

compilation_services_authorized.quote: The issuance of any report, including compilation reports, prescribed by the SASs, the SSARSs or the SSAEs on any services to which those statements on standards apply

education_semester_hours_required.quote: at least one hundred fifty (150) semester hours of college education, including a baccalaureate or higher degree conferred by a college or university acceptable to the board

practice_privilege_no_notice_required.quote: no notice or other submission shall be provided by the individual

value: Consent to personal and subject matter jurisdiction and disciplinary authority of the board
Comply with this chapter and the board's rules
Cease offering or rendering professional services if license from state of principal place of business is no longer valid
Appointment of the state board that issued the license as agent upon whom process may be served
practice_privilege_consent_conditions.quote: An individual licensee of another state exercising the privilege afforded under this section and the CPA firm that employs the licensee, as a condition of the grant of this privilege, simultaneously consent to the following

attest_services_require_firm_permit.quote: The holder of a certificate issued under this section may only provide attest services in a CPA firm that holds a permit issued under § 62-1-108.

firm_majority_cpa_ownership_required.quote: a simple majority of the beneficial ownership of the firm, in terms of financial interests in the equity capital and voting rights held by all partners, officers, shareholders, members or managers, belongs to holders of a certificate who are licensed in some state

nonlicensee_firm_owners_permitted.quote: Any CPA firm may include nonlicensee owners; provided, that:

peer_review_required_for_firm_renewal.quote: The board shall require, by rule, as a condition to renewal of permits under this section, that applicants enroll in a board approved peer review program and undergo at least once every three (3) years, peer reviews conducted in the manner that the board specifies.

peer_review_max_frequency_years.quote: undergo at least once every three (3) years, peer reviews conducted in the manner that the board specifies

peer_review_records_privileged.quote: the peer review processes be operated, and documents maintained, in a manner designed to preserve confidentiality under §§ 62-1-116 and 62-1-202 and that no third party, other than the board or the board's designee, shall have access to documents furnished or generated in the course of the peer review

inactive_license_status_available.quote: The board may by rule create an exception to this requirement for certificate holders who do not perform or offer to perform for the public one (1) or more kinds of services involving the use of accounting or auditing skills

office_supervision_by_licensed_cpa_requi.quote: all attest services rendered in this state are under the charge of a person holding a valid certificate issued under § 62-1-107 or the corresponding provision of prior law or some other state law

attest_report_signer_competency_requirem.quote: Any individual licensee who is responsible for supervising attest services and signs or authorizes someone to sign the accountants' report on the financial statements on behalf of the firm shall meet the experience requirements set out in the professional standards for those services

client_confidentiality_privilege.quote: Licensees shall not divulge, nor shall they in any manner be required to divulge, any information that is communicated to them or obtained by them by the reason of the confidential nature of their employment.

working_papers_ownership_by_licensee.quote: all statements, records, schedules, working papers and memoranda incident to or in the course of rendering services to a client, made by a licensee or a partner, shareholder, officer, director, member, manager or employee of a licensee... shall be and remain the property of the licensee in the absence of an express agreement between the licensee and the client to the contrary

commission_prohibition_during_attest.quote: A licensee shall neither pay any consideration or commission to obtain a client nor accept any consideration or commission for the referral of a client to others when the licensee or the licensee's firm also performs for that client any of the following: An audit or review of a financial statement

contingent_fee_prohibition_during_attest.quote: A licensee shall not receive or agree to receive a contingent fee from a client for the following: Performance of any professional services for a client for whom the licensee or person associated with the licensee performs any of the following: An audit or review of a financial statement

safe_harbor_disclaimer_language_for_nonl.quote: the board shall issue rules providing safe harbor language that nonlicensees may use in connection with the financial information

foreign_accountant_practice_exception.quote: None of the provisions of subsections (a)-(i) shall have any application to a person or firm holding a certification, designation, degree or license granted in a foreign country entitling the holder... to engage in the practice of accountancy or its equivalent in that country, whose activities in this state are limited to the provision of professional services to persons or firms who are residents of, governments of or business entities of the country

firm_corrective_action_period_for_owners.quote: Firms that fall out of compliance with the section due to changes in firm ownership or personnel after receiving or renewing a permit shall take corrective action to bring the firm back into compliance. The board may grant a reasonable period of time for a firm to take corrective action.

firm_permit_required_for_attest_services.quote: A firm must hold a permit issued under this section in order to provide attest services or to use the title "CPAs," "CPA firm," "PAs" or "PA firm."

client_records_return_obligation.quote: A licensee shall furnish to a client or former client, upon request and reasonable notice: A copy of the licensee's working papers, to the extent that the working papers include records that would ordinarily constitute part of the client's records and are not otherwise available to the client
